This section was drilled using a seawater gel system with viscous slugs every single and with WOB of 10-25#, RPM of 120-185 and pump pressure of 2100-3100 psi. The lithology consisted of soft plastic clay with traces of sand throughout. Rates of penetration averaged around 30-40 m/hr but increased in very sandy sections up to 176 m/hr.

Limestone/marl was encountered from approximately 1320m becoming more compacted around 1450m as stringers and having marked effect on rates of penetration. Slight gumbo problems were encountered in the latter part of this section but slower pump rates cured the problem by allowing surface equipment to clear. Background gas remained in the region of 10
